verdict.rationale: Logseq offers its own programmatic surfaces: a plugin system with a plugin API, and an official local HTTP API server with bearer-token auth and a POST /api endpoint that dispatches the plugin API methods. However, the evidence never names an official, versioned SDK package, and the plugin API reference is described as community-driven, which falls well short of first-party SDKs. Missing for 10: an explicitly official SDK library (named package, supported languages), first-party SDK documentation, an OpenAPI spec or versioning policy (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration of building against it.
